judge.agreement_reason: The recorded narrative identifies a deployment that swapped shippingservice's image to a JVM-based service, causing startup failure under an undersized memory limit. The agent narrative stops at 'shippingservice is unavailable' without identifying what made it unavailable or what changed.
dead_ends_closed: checkoutservice itself had not crashed or been restarted
dead_ends_missed: shippingservice's startup behavior (crash loop vs. killed container)
the language runtime change in shippingservice logs (Rust to JVM)
shippingservice's deployment history and image reference
whether the memory limit had changed

traps.trap: memory limit set below service needs (signature of JVM dying at startup)
raising the memory limit would stop the alert

judge.notes: The agent investigation correctly traced the failure to shippingservice unavailability but explicitly stopped without examining shippingservice itself. It never queried shippingservice logs, metrics, traces, or change history—the exact data that would have revealed the image swap. The recorded narrative treats the absence of investigation on the failing service as 'the single largest defect in this record.'
